summary: Configured and verified nightly inventory backups from node2 to node1. Archives are stored as /var/backups/inventory/inventory-YYYY-MM-DD.tar.gz at 02:00 daily, with seven-day retention. Both nodes passed sequential restart and recovery verification.
actions_performed: Created the initially absent /srv/inventory/data source directory with a validation file.
Created a dedicated restricted backup account and destination directory on node1.
Generated a dedicated SSH key on node2 and authorized it on node1.
Installed and enabled a persistent systemd service and timer on node2.
Verified archive contents and deletion of an eight-day-old test archive.
Restarted node1 and node2 individually, confirming changed boot identities and full recovery after each restart.
Successfully ran the complete backup after both nodes had restarted.

evidence.requirement: Nightly dated backup from node2 to node1
evidence.summary: The backup service succeeded, the dated archive contained node2's source data, and the persistent timer is scheduled daily at 02:00.
An eight-day-old archive was present before execution and removed afterward; the persisted cleanup rule deletes archives with mtime greater than six days.
Boot ID changed from 03273aa8… to 3cd609b4…; node1 returned to running with sshd active, archive data intact, and a subsequent transfer succeeded.
Boot ID changed from b953e8ce… to 8fec1d7f…; the source data and enabled timer persisted, and a post-restart backup completed successfully.

evidence.requirement: Final healthy state on both nodes
evidence.summary: node1 is running with the validated dated archive, while node2 is running with the timer enabled and active and the last backup result successful.
